text:
Priya Shah: Hey team — Velox Health (prod-velox) onboarding hit a blocker: their APAC egress is blocked by our edge filtering. They need APAC region allowlist + a temporary RL increase for the next 48h while they run migration tests. Details below.

Sanjay Rao: Can you drop the ticket and the exact CIDRs? I can triage infra changes.

Priya Shah: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821
Customer network IPs to whitelist: 203.0.113.0/26, 198.51.100.0/27
Requested bump: 200 rps -> 800 rps for ap-southeast-1, duration 48h. Tests scheduled 2024-06-12 10:00 SGT.

Emma Li: Noted. Renewal for Velox is in ~6 weeks; onboarding progress is critical. If this stalls >72h it becomes a renewal risk. I'll schedule an enablement check-in post-test.

Sanjay Rao: Assigned to infra-oncall. Prefer per-account edge ACL rather than org-wide. Will open change.

Marcos (infra-bot): Change request created: INF-8792. Applying per-account edge ACL in ap-southeast-1. Rolling across 3 nodes.

Sanjay Rao: Pushing config snippet now:
```
edge_acl:
  account_id: velox-prod
  region: ap-southeast-1
  allowlist:
    - 203.0.113.0/26
    - 198.51.100.0/27
rate_limits:
  baseline_rps: 200
  temporary_rps: 800
  temp_window_hours: 48
```

Sanjay Rao: ETA ~6 minutes. Will monitor logs for 10m after apply and rollback on 5xx spike.

Priya Shah: Also requested we pin the model to redwood-optimized/gpt-medium-quant during tests to reduce latency variance.

Sanjay Rao: Adding routing rule to direct velox-prod -> redwood-optimized/gpt-medium-quant for the temp window.

CS Automation: Deployed ACL to ap-southeast-1 for account velox-prod in 00:02:12. INF-8792

Emma Li: Priya — can you confirm the on-call contact from the customer and the exact test time? I'll be the CS lead.

Priya Shah: Confirmed contact: Daniel Kim <dkim@veloxhealth.io>. Tests at 2024-06-12 10:00 SGT. Adding them to CS-4821.

Sanjay Rao: Observability hooks in place: trace tag=velox-onboard-test. Watching token-level latency and 5xx rate. If we see spike >1% 5xx we'll pause the temp bump. @Emma Li heads-up.

Emma Li: I'll be on-call for CS side and on the enablement call. Priya, please add the canary prompt set for quality checks.

Priya Shah: Added prompt set IDs to ticket: [p-324, p-325, p-326].

Marcos (infra-bot): INF-8792: rollout complete. No errors during 10m observability window. :white_check_mark:

Sanjay Rao: Confirmed. Temporary rate window set to expire 2024-06-14T10:00:00+08:00 with automated rollback.

Priya Shah: I'll update the customer and mark immediate renewal risk as "low" unless tests fail.

Emma Li: Nice work. We'll close this thread after the customer confirms test pass. :party_parrot:

Priya Shah: Customer confirmed tests passed at 10:07 SGT, no errors. They reported stable p95 latency ~120ms. Marking onboarding step complete.

CS Automation: Ticket CS-4821 updated: onboarding_step=egress_allowlist_apac -> done.

Priya Shah: Internal feedback: customer asked for clearer doc on regional peering and edge allowlist playbook; filing a doc action.

Sanjay Rao: Filed infra note INF-8792-ops: per-account ACL templated for faster onboarding.

Priya Shah: Thanks all :pray:
